spans.s:
n. (-तं)
Injury of the lungs, breaking a blood vessel, consumption.
E.
उरस् and क्षत lesion.

n. (-लं)
The breast, the bosom.
E.
उरस् the breast, and स्थल place.

f. (-का)
A pearl necklace.
E.
उरस् the breast, सूत्र a thread, टच् aff.

Sautra root. (उरति)
To go.

m. (-गः)
A snake.
E.
उरस् the breast, and ग who goes, from गम to go, affix ड; also उरङ्ग and उरङ्गम.

n. (-नं)
The infernal regions below the earth.
E.
उरग and स्थान a place or country; the abode of the Nāgas or serpents.

m. (-रिः)
1 GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆ

A large crane.
E.
उरग a snake, and अरि the enemy.

n. (-नं)
1 A name of GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆ

The gigantic crane.
E.
उरग and अशन food; whose food is of serpents.

m. (-न्द्रः)
The king of snakes, ŚEṢA or VĀSUKI.
E.
उरग and इन्द्र chief.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A snake, a serpent: see उरग, the affix being खच्; also उरङ्गम.

m. (-णः)
1 A ram.
2 A cloud.
f. (-णी)
A ewe.
E.
ऋ to go, क्यु affix, leaving ण, and उ substituted for the antepenultimate.

m. (-क्षः)
Cassia, (Alata).
E.
उरण ram, अक्ष an eye: the flower being so compared: क being added, also उरणाक्षक.

m. (-ख्यः)
Cassia: see the preceding.
E.
उरण and आख्या a name; named from the ram; also उरणाख्यक, क being added.

m. (-भ्रः)
A ram.
E.
उरु much, भ्रम to wander, ड affix, and the final of उरु dropped.

ind.
A particle implying,
1

Assent.
2

Expansion: (it chiefly occurs in composition.)
E.
वे to weave, ररीक aff.

ind.
1 A particle of assent.
3 Of expansion.
E.
ऊय to sew, &c. ररोक affix: see उररी.

m. (-रः)
A promise, an agreement.
E.
उररी, कार what makes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Promised, agreed.
2 Spread, diffused.
E.
उररी and कृत made.

m. (-दः)
Armour, mail.
E.
उरस् the breast, and छद a covering.

mfn. (उराः-उराः-उरः)
Best, excellent.
n. (-रः)
The breast, the bosom.
E.
ऋ to go, Uṇādi affix असुन्, the pen. changed to उ; also उर a Sautra root, to go, and असुन् as before.

m. (-जः)
The female breast.
E.
उरस् the breast, in the 7th case, ज produced.

m. (-हः)
The female breast.
E.
उरसि on the breast, and रुह what grows.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Broad-chested, having a full or broad breast.
E.
उरस् and इलच् aff.

m. (-टः)
The sacrificial thread hung round the neck and upon the breast, as it is sometimes worn.
E.
उरस् the breast, कट to encompass, अल् aff.

ind.
From the breast.
E.
उरस् and तसि aff.

n. (-णं)
Mail, the breastplate or cuirass.
E.
उरस्, त्रै to preserve, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
From the breast.
mf. (-स्यः-स्या)
A legitimate son or daughter, that is, one born from a married couple of the same tribe or cast.
E.
उरस the breast, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्)
Broad-chested, full-breasted, strong.
E.
उरस् and मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-हः)
A horse of a pale colour, with dark legs.

m. (-व्यः)
A man of the third cast or tribe, the merchant or husbandman, the Vaiśya.
E.
ऊरु a thigh, and यत् affix; being born from the thighs of BRAHMĀ.
